pack.source_script_insight: The source highlights a custom roof water channel system designed to direct rainwater. For Coimbatore home buyers, inspecting roof drainage channels, gutters, and slopes is critical to prevent water logging and structural dampness during monsoons.
pack.coimbatore_angle: Focuses on independent villas and penthouses in Coimbatore (e.g., Saravanampatti, Vadavalli) where heavy seasonal rains require robust roof drainage checks before purchase.
pack.core_takeaway: Always inspect roof drainage slopes, gutter joints, and rainwater outlets to prevent water stagnation and ceiling dampness.

pack.gemini_video_prompt:
Create a highly realistic, 10-second, 7-scene vertical 9:16 video concept for OliveTree SafeBuy, targeted strictly at Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. The video must look like high-quality, authentic smartphone or gimbal footage taken during real-world property inspections. No 2D/3D animations, cartoon styles, or glossy corporate graphics. 

Scene 1 (0.0-1.4s): Start with a strong hook. A close-up shot of rainwater overflowing from a clogged concrete roof gutter, cascading down a villa's exterior wall. The setting is a realistic Coimbatore villa with wet brick textures. Camera is low-angle, handheld style with slight natural shake. Overlay text: 'Roof Leakage?'. Tamil VO: 'கோயம்புத்தூர் வில்லா வாங்குறீங்களா?'.

Scene 2 (1.4-2.8s): Transition to a close-up of an inspector's hand placing a professional spirit level tool inside a concrete roof drainage channel on a sunny day. Camera tilts down to focus on the spirit level bubble. Overlay text: 'Check Slope'. Tamil VO: 'மொட்டை மாடி'.

Scene 3 (2.8-4.2s): Show a macro shot of a cracked PVC rainwater downpipe joint connected to the edge of a concrete roof slab. Visible dust and minor moss growth on the concrete. Static camera, sharp focus on the hairline crack. Overlay text: 'Pipe Joints'. Tamil VO: 'மழைநீர் வடிகால்'.

Scene 4 (4.2-5.6s): Show the interior consequence. A slow pan up from a bedroom window to the ceiling corner directly below the roof, revealing yellow-brown dampness patches on the white plaster. Overlay text: 'Ceiling Dampness'. Tamil VO: 'சரிவை செக் பண்ணுங்க!'.

Scene 5 (5.6-7.0s): Show a positive solution. Clean rainwater flowing smoothly through a well-installed PVC filter system attached to the villa's external wall. Medium eye-level shot tracking the water flow. Overlay text: 'RWH Filter'. Tamil VO: 'கசிவு இல்லாத'.

Scene 6 (7.0-8.4s): Show an inspector wearing a safety vest holding a digital tablet, checking off a roof drainage checklist on a modern Coimbatore villa terrace. Over-the-shoulder shot with a slight push-in. Overlay text: 'SafeBuy Check'. Tamil VO: 'வீட்டை தேர்வு செய்ய'.

Scene 7 (8.4-10.0s): End with a wide drone shot slowly rising and backing away from a beautiful, dry, perfectly sloped modern villa roof in Coimbatore under a clear blue sky. Transparent 'OliveTree SafeBuy' logo overlay. No full-screen end card. Tamil VO: 'ஆலிவ்ட்ரீ சேஃப்பாய் நாடுங்கள்!'.

NEGATIVE PROMPT: Do not use any cartoon, 2D explainer, flat vector graphics, glossy corporate motion graphics, plastic CGI, fake futuristic cities, or floating 3D documents. No presenters on camera. No religious symbols. Do not show any city other than Coimbatore. Do not use landscape format or black bars.
